## Problem

What rendering or host-integration problem would this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the expected behavior and, if useful, a small API example (component
input, provider option, or `core` type).

## Host-agnostic check

The library owns rendering mechanics, not host meaning. If the proposal needs
host knowledge, sketch the seam (injection token, provider option) that would
keep it out of the library.

## Alternatives

What workarounds or alternatives have you considered?
